# Holes are the grammar's interpolation nodes. `''${` is nix's escape for
# a literal `${` and is NOT a hole; the string inside the second hole is
# nix code, not a site of its own.
systemd.services.hello.script | '' | bash errexit | ${pkgs.hello}, ${lib.optionalString debug "set -x"} | "\n    ${pkgs.hello}/bin/hello --greeting \"''${GREETING:-hi}\"\n    ${lib.optionalString debug \"set -x\"}\n  "
